negative_control_blanked_evidence.not_applicable_reason: label regression predicate is pinned to the 65-row incumbent population; this control cannot fire on the adjudicated packet's population

admission_reading.exit_certifies: PASS_NO_REGRESSION — gates executed, no gate_blocks_build. In served_lineage mode this additionally certifies the served bytes are unchanged and the incumbents recompute exactly. In adjudicate mode it does NOT certify that the label bar was met; read the per-gate regression_verdict and absolute_status first.

label.regression_certifies: NOTHING about label soundness. It is an inapplicability marker, not a pass.
label.regression_does_not_certify: NOT_APPLICABLE does NOT certify that counter-label support met any bar. A packet whose scored support collapsed to 0 outside the 65-row population still reports NOT_APPLICABLE with gate_blocks_build=false. Absolute status (LABEL_SOUND/UNSOUND) is the only label statement the gate makes about such a packet, and it is never enforced as a build blocker.
label.absolute_certifies: every scored counter row on THIS packet carries evidence the frozen rubric accepts
label.absolute_does_not_certify: either state says nothing about map geometry, retrieval recall or jurist usefulness; LABEL_UNSOUND is REPORTED, never a build blocker (direction v50)

geometry.regression_certifies: no criterion-count regression on the three frozen qids
geometry.regression_does_not_certify: does not certify the absolute 11/11 bar (accepted served bundles pass regression at 6/5/5 and are GEOMETRY_UNSOUND)
geometry.absolute_certifies: at least one criterion fails on at least one bundle
geometry.absolute_does_not_certify: either state says nothing about counter-label support or jurist usefulness; GEOMETRY_UNSOUND is REPORTED, never a build blocker (direction v50)

admission_reading.required_reading: gate_blocks_build==false / exit 0 is NOT a statement that the counter-label bar was met; read label absolute_status explicitly for packets outside the pinned 65-row incumbent population

absolute_status_summary.note: absolute bars REPORTED only; they do not block the build (direction v50)
